# FDGA065

> DO name the source file with the name of the public type it contains.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section A.4 File Organization.

This is a coding style convention. The book treats the appendix A conventions as suggestions, so you can override it.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library warning, application warning, test warning
- Status: verified

planned-analyzer: file name that differs from the public type name.

## From the book

For example, the `String` class should be in a file named “String.cs” and the `List<T>` class should be in a file named “List.cs”.
